content.value_statement: Financial research requests can become inconsistent when filing, ownership, and macro questions use different evidence standards. This skill routes each request to a focused workflow that uses dated LLMQuant Data and clearly separates retrieved facts from interpretation.
actual_capabilities: Routes 10-K requests to a workflow covering business, risk factors, and MD&A evidence.
Guides ticker-level 13F holder analysis with ranking periods and scope limitations.
Builds U.S. macro snapshots across inflation, labor, rates, growth, liquidity, and curve signals.
Composes market-facing macro briefs from indicators, prices, crypto, and research context.
Requires dates, filing periods, coverage notices, and missing inputs in research outputs.
Separates retrieved evidence from interpretation and states when data is unavailable.
limitations: It depends on LLMQuant Data or a compatible data MCP for external facts.
It does not retrieve data or execute analysis without an available connected data source.
13F results are delayed, long-only, U.S.-listed, and limited to the available universe.
It does not provide certain forecasts or treat unsupported indicators as retrieved evidence.

use_cases.title: Review a Company Filing
use_cases.description: Create a dated 10-K review covering business context, risk factors, MD&A trends, monitoring signals, and the data used.

use_cases.title: Map Institutional Holders
use_cases.description: Identify leading 13F managers for a ticker, assess reported concentration, and present the limits of the ownership data.

use_cases.title: Frame the Macro Regime
use_cases.description: Build a compact macro snapshot or market brief with dated indicators, policy context, asset implications, and risks to the view.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Filing Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the latest 10-K for [ticker]. Cover the business, risk factors, MD&A, filing metadata, and three monitoring signals. Use only retrieved evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Find Ticker Holders
prompt_templates.prompt: For [ticker], identify the top 13F holders in the latest available universe. Include ranking period, period of report, position values, concentration, and scope caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Macro Snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a U.S. macro regime snapshot for [date]. Cover inflation, labor, rates, curve, growth, and liquidity. Show each observation date and distinguish facts from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Market Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Compose a market-facing macro brief for [region], [horizon], and [assets]. Combine macro history, current indicators, prices, and relevant research. State the dominant regime, contradiction, asset implications, risks, and next data.

output_examples.input: Review the latest 10-K for ACME and focus on downside risks.
output_examples.output: A structured filing review with a bottom line, filing metadata, an evidence table, MD&A readthrough, monitoring checklist, and data-used section.

output_examples.input: Who are the largest reported 13F holders of XYZ?
output_examples.output: A holder summary with ranked managers, reported values, report periods, a crowding read, and explicit delayed-data and universe limitations.

output_examples.input: What is the current U.S. macro regime?
output_examples.output: A dated dashboard across inflation, labor, rates, growth, liquidity, and curve signals, followed by policy context, market readthrough, and watch items.

best_practices: Provide the ticker, region, time horizon, period, and desired deliverable.
Require observation dates, filing periods, coverage notices, and the exact data capabilities used.
Treat interpretations as separate from retrieved facts and state missing or unavailable inputs.
anti_patterns: Do not call delayed 13F data current ownership or infer short positions from missing filings.
Do not mix data frequencies or claim a regime change from one noisy observation without context.
Do not add outside facts, unsupported indicators, or policy forecasts as if they were retrieved evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill route?
faq.answer: It routes 10-K reviews, 13F holder research, U.S. macro snapshots, and market-facing macro briefs.

faq.question: Which data source does it use?
faq.answer: It prefers LLMQuant Data for filings, holdings, macro indicators, prices, crypto, and research context.

faq.question: Can it work without LLMQuant Data?
faq.answer: It asks for user-provided data or names missing inputs when no compatible data source is available.

faq.question: Are 13F results current ownership?
faq.answer: No. 13F data is delayed, long-only, U.S.-listed, and limited to the available reporting universe.

faq.question: Does it make investment decisions?
faq.answer: No. It organizes evidence and interpretation, while users assess suitability, uncertainty, and investment decisions.

faq.question: How should macro results be interpreted?
faq.answer: Use the dated observations and stated frequency caveats. Treat regime labels and policy implications as analysis, not certainty.
